loot_policy: Members, no wealth, off-task, pre-Legends. Exclusive pre-roll then full conditional main pool; independent visage/talisman where specified. Source unlisted lizardman mass is empty, not renormalized.

source_assumptions: Off-task unique rates; pre-roll is an exclusive unique selection before the conditional main table. Visage/talisman independent of the main roll. Quest/diary/task-only drops excluded.
Lizardman source lists only seed/fang/fabric/talisman drops; remaining mass is explicit Nothing, not renormalized. 25% poison proc and 50% close-range ranged choice are prototype policies.

Wyvern herbs follow source prose: exactly three herbs; template range1-3 conflicts. Unprotected icy breath0-60 is a provisional cap because source specifies only50+. Breath choice1/3; freeze6.6seconds and1/7 protected freeze chance follow Wiki; unprotected always freezes prototype.

Drake breath7autos then4hits6-8; ground radius2.5yards,1200ms initial warning and600ms pulses chosen for WoW prototype, locked to intended victim. Anti-dragon shield reduces each hit0-4; potions/protection prayers not implemented.
Xil ring permanently switches to melee after a skipped attack turn on reaching melee range, until reset. Wyrm attack choice50% near; magic only at distance.
Slayer thresholds and XP are reference metadata only, following previous batches; no Slayer skill gate/task XP added. Native WoW regen, neutral faction attackability and WoW sounds retained.
Noted loot uses collectible identity and full quantity without a separate bank-note system. Tokkul remains a200-stack collectible; no spending or Coin conversion.

TzHaar-Xil published rows sum129/128: unique gear1/128 plus a complete common table. Use gear as an exclusive pre-roll, with common rows conditional on no gear; do not renormalize the whole table. This source ambiguity needs future confirmation.
